fields.summary_ko.0: Lucid Group (NASDAQ:LCID) secured an additional $1.75B credit facility from PIF, providing approximately $4B liquidity and operational funding through end of 2027, though Q3 saw a $831M net loss exceeding $350M revenue
fields.summary_ko.1: Cash burn decreased 30% quarter-over-quarter and gross margin improved to approximately -74%; however, PIF-related debt increased from zero at year-start to approximately $2B, intensifying reliance on a single investor
